success.assertion: test('4951/2151临时上限当前HP与速度等级待答保持真实整回合回滚，独立容量公式零等级按60%面板',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(s,10001,20309),/Q-4951-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);const old=E.SOULS;let capacity;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){capacity=old.registry[2151].abilities.capacity(c);return;}old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s,10001,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(capacity,{speed:500,rate:60,amount:300});const x=make({move:10001,soul:true});x.fighters[0].stages.spe=1;assert.throws(()=>turn(x,10001,20309),/Q-4951-001/);});

success.name: 4951/2151已损HP附粉60至120独立递增封顶，属性与药剂不递增，粉免仍执行记录
success.assertion: test('4951/2151已损HP附粉60至120独立递增封顶，属性与药剂不递增，粉免仍执行记录',()=>withoutCapacity(()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000,loadout:[10001,20017,29468,29469,38572]});for(const rate of[60,80,100,120,120]){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),1000*rate/100);}const before=s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate;turn(s,20017,20309);turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,before);const x=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(x,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,80);}));

effectInstances.description: 4回合内免疫并反弹所有受到的异常状态

moves.name: 徐风缠绕

effectInstances.description: 全属性+1，自身满体力时强化效果翻倍
4回合内每回合使用技能吸取对手300点体力，吸取体力时若自身当前体力低于对手则吸取效果提升至450点
下2次选择使用攻击技能时将对手的能力提升状态视为相应的能力下降状态
下2回合令自身所有技能先制+2
